title: 第528章 硬撼大帝意志第527章 大帝之威
slug: 我纨绔世子开局征服太子妃
content_zh:
轰——！
剑光与拳头，在半空中轰然相撞。
没有惊天动地的巨响，只有一片极致的死寂。
碰撞的中心，空间如同镜面一般，寸寸破碎，化作了一个深不见底的黑色空洞，疯狂地吞噬着周围的一切。
咔嚓！
仅仅僵持了不到一个呼吸的时间。
那道混沌剑光便发出一声哀鸣，轰然破碎。
蕴含着帝威的金色拳头，余势不减，结结实实地轰在了楚风的胸膛之上。
噗！
楚风如遭雷击，口中喷出的金色血液，瞬间染红了天际。
他身上的不灭之体，在这一拳之下，如同瓷器般布满了裂痕，身体不受控制地朝着后方疯狂倒飞出去，一连撞碎了十几座山脉，才勉强停下。
“哈哈哈哈……去死吧！楚风！给我死！”
金无极见状，发出一阵癫狂的大笑，他操控着黄金战神虚影，再次举起了拳头，朝着已然重伤的楚风，再次轰杀而来！
看着那再次轰来的，蕴含着无上伟力的金色拳头，楚风挣扎着从废墟中站起，抹了一把嘴角的鲜血，眼中同样燃起了疯狂的火焰。
他能感觉到，自己体内的骨骼，至少断了一半，五脏六腑都已移位，经脉更是寸寸断裂。
若非不灭之体足够强悍，刚才那一拳，足以让他当场灰飞烟灭。
“再来！”
楚风发出一声嘶吼，非但没有后退，反而拖着重伤之躯，主动迎了上去。
他知道，自己已经避无可避。
这一战，要么他死，要么金无极亡！

就在这生死一线之际，他体内深处，那股一直沉寂的，源自于父亲楚狂龙，源自于楚家列祖列宗的神秘血脉，仿佛受到了那股帝威的挑衅和刺激，终于……苏醒了！
轰！
一股比那帝威更加古老、更加霸道、仿佛来自于混沌之初的血脉之力，在他体内轰然炸开！
这股力量，充满了原始的野性与不屈的战意，仿佛要战天，战地，战尽诸天神佛！
在这股血脉之力的冲刷下，楚风断裂的经脉，竟然在以一种不可思议的速度愈合，他身上的气息，也开始节节攀升！
“杀！”
楚风的双眸，彻底化作了一片血红，理智被那股狂暴的战意所淹没。
他放弃了所有功法，放弃了所有武技，只是遵从着血脉最深处的本能，握紧了拳头，朝着那落下的黄金战神虚影，一拳轰出！
这一拳，没有法则，没有神通，只有最纯粹，最原始，最霸道的力量！
远处的观战者，全都看傻了。
他们只看到，在那尊万丈高的黄金战神虚影面前，一道渺小如同蝼蚁的身影，竟然不自量力地，挥拳迎了上去。
“疯了……他彻底疯了！”
“用肉拳去硬撼大帝意志的一击？他这是在找死！”
就连远方被楚风推开的诸葛玥和月婵仙子，都看得心惊肉跳，一颗心瞬间提到了嗓子眼。
下一秒。
一大一小，两个不成比例的拳头，在所有人的注视下狠狠地撞在了一起。
轰隆——！
content_en:
boom--!
The sword light and fist collided in mid-air.
There was no earth-shattering noise, just the ultimate silence.
At the center of the collision, the space was like a mirror, shattered inch by inch, turning into a bottomless black hole, wildly devouring everything around it.
Click!
The stalemate lasted less than a breath.
The chaotic sword light let out a cry and shattered.
The golden fist, which contained the power of the emperor, remained unabated and struck Chu Feng's chest firmly.
puff!
As if Chu Feng was struck by lightning, the golden blood spurted from his mouth instantly dyed the sky red.
His immortal body was filled with cracks like porcelain under this punch. His body flew backwards uncontrollably, smashing more than a dozen mountains in a row before barely stopping.
"Hahahaha...go to hell! Chu Feng! Die!"
Seeing this, Jin Wuji let out a maniacal laugh. He controlled the golden shadow of the God of War, raised his fist again, and struck towards the seriously injured Chu Feng again!
Looking at the golden fist that struck again, containing supreme power, Chu Feng struggled to stand up from the ruins, wiped the blood from the corner of his mouth, and his eyes also ignited with crazy flames.
He could feel that at least half of the bones in his body were broken, his internal organs had been displaced, and his meridians were broken inch by inch.
If the immortal body hadn't been strong enough, the punch just now would have been enough to wipe him out on the spot.
"Come again!"
Chu Feng let out a roar, and instead of retreating, he took the initiative to face him while dragging his seriously injured body.
He knew that he had no escape.
In this battle, either he dies or Jin Wuji dies!
At this critical moment between life and death, deep within his body, the mysterious bloodline that had been silent, originated from his father Chu Kuanglong, and from the ancestors of the Chu family, seemed to be provoked and stimulated by the imperial power, and finally... woke up!
boom!
A bloodline power that was older and more domineering than the Emperor's power, as if it came from the beginning of chaos, exploded within his body!
This force is full of primitive wildness and unyielding fighting spirit, as if it wants to fight the heavens and the earth, and fight all the gods and Buddhas!
Under the wash of this blood power, Chu Feng's broken meridians were healing at an incredible speed, and the aura on his body also began to rise steadily!
"Kill!"
Chu Feng's eyes turned completely blood red, and his reason was overwhelmed by the violent fighting spirit.
He gave up all his kung fu and all his martial arts, and just followed the deepest instinct of his bloodline. He clenched his fist and punched the falling shadow of the golden God of War!
This punch has no rules or magical powers, only the purest, most primitive, and most domineering power!
The spectators in the distance were all dumbfounded.
They only saw a figure as small as an ant in front of the phantom of the 10,000-foot-tall golden God of War, and he waved his fist to meet him without overestimating his own strength.
"Crazy...he's completely crazy!"
"A blow to shake the emperor's will with a physical fist? He is looking for death!"
Even Zhuge Yue and Fairy Yuechan, who were pushed away by Chu Feng in the distance, were so frightened that their hearts suddenly rose to their throats.
The next second.
Two disproportionate fists, one big and one small, collided fiercely under everyone's gaze.
Boom——!
